purpose: Classify the current production/reference semantic surface before any Foundation-v2 production rewrite and select the minimal exact-occurrence substrate direction without retaining old semantics behind adapters.

classification.PRESERVE: semantics or mechanism survives into the new canonical path
classification.TOOLING_ONLY: may remain for parsing, diagnostics, formatting or historical tooling but cannot define semantic identity
classification.REPLACE: current production semantic responsibility must move to the Foundation-v2 substrate
classification.HISTORICAL_REPLAY_ONLY: kept only to replay/version historical accepted contracts; not part of the new live semantic path

replaceOrExtend: rooted copied-value snapshot as the only semantic carrier

testLifecycle.historicalAcceptedContractTests: keep immutable/replayable under their historical version
